title: Understanding Invertibility
text: For a matrix to be invertible, it must be square and have full rank. Consider what this means for the design matrix X in the context of logistic regression.

title: Properties of $$X^{TX}$$
text: The matrix $$X^{TX}$$ is square if X has more rows than columns. Think about how this affects the invertibility of $$X^{TX}$$.

hintAnswer: X must have full column rank.
title: Checking Matrix Dimensions
text: What must be true about the dimensions of X for $$X^{TX}$$ to be invertible?
choices: X must have full column rank.
X must have full row rank.
X must be a square matrix.
X must be a diagonal matrix.
